provenance.selection: Decode scalar constants plus each object row using interned nodes, keys and boolean shapes; compatibility deltas are irrelevant. Group exact case-sensitive row IDs. Prefer canonical provider rows over relay copies. If projected contextWindow, maxTokens and representable cost differ among selected rows, store null (ambiguous). Otherwise retain the shared projection. Add canonical provider/id keys from canonical rows, preferring these over relay copies; never strip suffixes or infer versions.
provenance.pricing: USD per million tokens from source ModelCost. Preserve input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite. All-zero rates without explicit free status, included/variable/unknown status, missing/invalid rates, unknown cost fields, timeBased schedules, and unrepresentable thresholds yield pricing null, never zero or a flattened tariff. longContext is a full replacement card; inputThresholdInclusive=false/absent maps to min_input_tokens=threshold+1; true maps to threshold. Null contextWindow/maxTokens stay null.
provenance.application: Runtime fills missing context_window, chat pricing and protocol-compatible chat reasoning unless explicitly disabled. Explicit reasoning wins unchanged. OpenAi effort supports Chat Completions and Responses; AnthropicAdaptive supports Anthropic Messages only. max_output is inspection metadata, not a request reservation. Derived settings are not saved as user overrides. Public list-price estimates are not relay bills. Vision respects vision_override, then legacy true, then exact source input. Chat-only tool defaults fill supports_tools=None; explicit false wins. Legacy ModelEntry true capability flags participate before reference defaults. Derived capability metadata is not persisted.

provenance.reasoning: Project thinking.mode=effort only for source openai-completions/openai-responses APIs to OpenAi; anthropic-adaptive only for anthropic-messages to AnthropicAdaptive. Preserve the exact ordered source efforts (first is default), never inject none/minimal or token budgets. Budget, anthropic-budget-effort, Google/local/other API modes and conflicting reasoning projections remain unknown. Canonical/exact identity selection is unchanged; existing ambiguous model rows remain null. Compatibility deltas do not define these source thinking fields. Matching reasoning for identities with conflicting limits/prices is stored independently in ambiguous_reasoning, without making ambiguous limits/prices known.
provenance.capabilities: For existing nonnull exact identities only, use the same canonical-provider preference as selection. Project supports_vision from source input containing image (false for an explicit list without image, unknown if absent). Project supports_tools from explicit boolean supportsTools; otherwise true only when applyPatchToolType=freeform or supportsComputerUse=true declares an actual supported native tool API. Omitted supportsTools, generic protocol/API names and false supportsComputerUse are not evidence of false tool support. Each field must agree across all selected rows or remain null. Ambiguous identities remain unknown; no aliases or version inference added.
